question: Nobody is twice your height, yet some people are a million times richer. Bell curve or long tail?
answer: Nobody is twice your height, yet some people are a million times richer. Heights bunch near the average in a bell curve, while wealth has a long tail, with a few giants far out. When one case can be 1,000 times the typical, the average will fool you.
